---
title: "Source-traceable supplementary data review package"
format: html
---

Packages explicit active analysis sources without changing values, assigning final
table numbers, or reviving quarantined reports. This is a review package.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,json,sys,zipfile,io
root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived')
out=Path(sys.argv[1]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
groups={}
def add(group,folder,names):
    for name in names:
        p=root/folder/name
        assert p.is_file(),str(p)
        groups.setdefault(group,[]).append(p)
def all_tsv(group,folder):
    files=sorted((root/folder).glob('*.tsv'))
    assert files,folder
    add(group,folder,[p.name for p in files])
add('concordance','community_cross_omics_permutation_2026-09-16-v3/tables',
    ['bray_curtis_matrix_permutation_tests.tsv','permutation_null_summary.tsv'])
all_tsv('community','community_cycle_models_catalogue_aligned_2026-09-16-v1/tables')
add('community','votu_taxonomic_resolution_review_2026-09-13-v4/tables',['catalogue_rank_assignments.tsv'])
add('community','supplementary_votu_realm_bars_2026-09-22-v2',['plotted_values.tsv','CAPTION.txt'])
v1='16s_analysis/09_return_package'

add('transcriptome','full_transcriptome_de/tables',[

descriptions={
 'concordance':'Table S1 sources. Three assay-pair correlations; global and constrained permutation tests; separate BH families. The 66 pairwise distances arise from 12 samples.',
 'community':'Current MAG/vOTU count matrices, eligibility, complete abundance tests and diagnostics. 634 eligible vOTUs; 578 passed expression-count filtering. Composition includes all 634. Gene expression is a different analysis.',
 '16S_v1':'Author-retained accepted v1 counts, taxonomy, community analyses and executed settings. No v2-only feature-level models or earlier-cohort comparison. Original sample labels are preserved.',
 'transcriptome':'Complete-universe edgeR results and model provenance. Functional lists are interpreted after these global tests. Main condition, coefficient-specific interactions and omnibus interaction are separate endpoints.',
 'biofilm_SOS':'Combined biofilm and separate SOS gene membership, MAG assignments and dependence-aware concentration tests. The display label Other MAGs in the contributor table is a plotting aggregation, not a taxonomic identity; use MAG_ID and genus.',
 'population_genomics':'Source panels and reference-denominator audit for the current five-MAG, 139-qualified-comparison display. Unavailable comparisons are not zero differences.',
 'cleaning_models':'Fixed cleaning-index inputs; condition-only, categorical-cycle and linear-cycle models; all 14 candidates, scenarios and coefficient intervals. Scenario effects are cleaning-score units, not percent biofilm removal. Duplicate views are retained with source paths, not pooled.',
 'all_MAG_context':'All-MAG single-predictor estimates and their summaries by expression category. Group IQRs summarize individual estimates; they are not confidence intervals. Joint multi-group interventions are not included.',
 'mapping_provenance':'Coassembly flagstat-derived alignment-record fractions. These include secondary records and are not primary-read or MAG/vOTU-catalogue recovery rates.',
 'functional_recurrence':'Eight prespecified stress categories interpreted after full-transcriptome DE, plus all-gene descriptive six-cell recurrence and plotted selections. Recurrence is descriptive, not an additional hypothesis test. Combined biofilm results are in biofilm_SOS, not replaced by these categories.',
 'software':'Evidence-linked upstream inventory plus executed downstream and retained 16S v1 software records. Upstream table explicitly lists remaining unverified versions/categories. Current installed versions are not substituted for historical execution versions.',
 'host_phage':'All 86 frozen network links (80 MAGs, 85 viral contigs), original scores, quality records and current taxonomy/abundance scope. All 85 assignments agree with archived cluster membership. Neither their representatives nor other members of those clusters overlap the 634-vOTU abundance universe. Network and abundance analyses therefore retain explicitly different scopes. No new clustering or host prediction was performed.'}

manifest=[]; schema=[]
for group,paths in groups.items():
 for p in paths:
    rel=p.relative_to(root)
    dest=str(Path(group)/rel)
    blob=p.read_bytes()
    entry=dict(group=group,archive_path=dest,source_derived_relative=str(rel),bytes=len(blob),sha256=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest())
    manifest.append(entry)
    if p.suffix=='.tsv':
      with p.open() as f:
        rd=csv.reader(f,delimiter='\t'); columns=next(rd); count=sum(1 for _ in rd)
      schema.append(dict(archive_path=dest,rows=count,columns=columns))
assert len({r['archive_path'] for r in manifest})==len(manifest)
readme='''# Supplementary source data: author review

Not submission-ready: final numbering, full column definitions, remaining software-version provenance and journal-sized file allocation are still pending. Exact combined biofilm keyword provenance, full functional/recurrence sources, software records and archived-cluster reconciliation of host-linked viral contigs are included.

16S v1 is retained. No v2-only results, earlier-cohort comparisons, subset-first differential expression or obsolete viral abundance analyses are included. Values are copied without reformatting or recomputation. Group names are descriptive, not final supplementary numbers.

MANIFEST.json links each archive member to its exact derived source and SHA256. COLUMN_INDEX.json lists original columns and row counts; this is a schema index, not a completed data dictionary. Group READMEs give interpretation boundaries. Missing values remain missing. Do not infer zero from NA. P-value columns remain exactly as produced; consult the source models for the correction family.
'''
zpath=out/'supplementary-source-data-review.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as z:
 z.writestr('README.md',readme)
 z.writestr('MANIFEST.json',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
 z.writestr('COLUMN_INDEX.json',json.dumps(schema,indent=2))
 for group,desc in descriptions.items(): z.writestr(group+'/README.md','# '+group+'\n\n'+desc+'\n')
 for r in manifest: z.write(root/r['source_derived_relative'],r['archive_path'])
with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as z:
 assert z.testzip() is None
 for r in manifest: assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(r['archive_path'])).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
(out/'MANIFEST.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
(out/'COLUMN_INDEX.json').write_text(json.dumps(schema,indent=2))
(out/'README.md').write_text(readme+'\n## Groups\n\n'+'\n'.join('- **'+k+'**: '+v for k,v in descriptions.items()))
(out/'CHECKS.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source_files=len(manifest),groups=len(groups),all_zip_members_verified=True,
 zip_bytes=zpath.stat().st_size,zip_sha256=hashlib.sha256(zpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),status='AUTHOR_REVIEW_PARTIAL_NOT_SUBMISSION'),indent=2))
print(zpath); print(len(manifest),'source files;',zpath.stat().st_size,'bytes; every archive member hash verified')
```
